## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmed by (1) Energy/Healthcare/Staples leading while Tech/Financials lag and (2) leadership broad across sectors with Top 5 spread over 4 sectors, plus multiple large-cap trend-exhaustion signals suppressing directional conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.44%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strong: UNH (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.44% | 1M: -3.34%) RECOVERY. Consumer Staples positive: PM (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) ABOVE TREND, WMT (1W: +0.78% | 1M: +5.51%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: -6.87% | 1M: +6.56%) CORRECTION.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities lag: CEG (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND and Utilities overall weak. Consumer Discretionary under pressure: BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -3.13% | 1M: +5.78%) CORRECTION. Communication soft: CHTR (1W: -9.38% | 1M: -40.53%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: +0.75% | 1M: -9.25%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CSCO (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%) ABOVE TREND; OXY (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%) ABOVE TREND; PM (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) ABOVE TREND; F (1W: +10.14% | 1M: +9.07%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AMD (1W: -6.83% | 1M: +52.41%) CORRECTION, EL (1W: -6.87% | 1M: +6.56%) CORRECTION, BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.11% | 1M: +0.74%) CORRECTION, QCOM (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +49.84%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Technology and select Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: CSCO (1W: +22.41%), PANW (1W: +16.81%), OXY (1W: +12.43%), PM (1W: +10.89%), F (1W: +10.14%) — watch follow-through; market shows MAJOR DIVERGENCE (multiple large-cap 1W vs 1M mismatches), so treat momentum as tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed, internally divergent: AAPL (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +14.09%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +0.39%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +13.60%) ABOVE TREND while GOOGL (1W: -1.00% | 1M: +18.08%) CORRECTION and INTC (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%) CORRECTION; Tech 1W weakness with strong 1M gains signals rotation/take profits.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Cautious tone: JPM (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -3.92%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +3.59%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: -0.26% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND — Financials are mixed and not confirming a clear value/cyclical bid.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive support present: UNH (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +11.36%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.44% | 1M: -3.34%) RECOVERY; Healthcare showing relative resilience amid mixed tape.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to Energy and Healthcare names showing ABOVE TREND while reducing exposure to lagging Tech and stressed Financials; style mixed / no clear leadership. Given MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps, emphasize position-level confirmation and avoid broad conviction until breadth improves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CSCO (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.11% | 1M: +0.74%) CORRECTION, AMD (1W: -6.83% | 1M: +52.41%) CORRECTION — watch earnings/guidance flow and any catalyst-driven gap risk.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +5.82%) and Healthcare (1W: +0.70% | 1M: -2.24%) for strength; BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.51% | 1M: +12.74%) and Financials (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -2.12%) for potential further rotation; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch CSCO breakout above recent highs for momentum continuation; monitor XOM sustaining 1W gains as confirmation for Energy leadership; AAPL support at recent 1M trend (~previous consolidation) as a tech risk/re-entry trigger; UNH hold above its 1M highs to validate Healthcare leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
CEG (+80): CEG (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND — strong news but price diverging (distribution). PFE (+75): PFE (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -5.41%) BELOW TREND — bullish FDA news but price not confirming. PM (+60): PM (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. QCOM (+55): QCOM (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +49.84%) CORRECTION — bullish sentiment vs 1W weakness indicates take-profit rotation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (-55): BA (1W: -7.11% | 1M: +0.74%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines aligning with price weakness. BKNG (-55): BKNG (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. TSLA (-50): TSLA (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +8.57%) CORRECTION — headlines add downside risk to a stretched 1M. MA (-50): MA (1W: -0.26% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND — analyst pressure confirming recent softness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership. Energy and Healthcare names (XOM ABOVE TREND, UNH ABOVE TREND, PM ABOVE TREND) are showing relative strength. Major divergence among large caps and bullish headlines unconfirmed by price (e.g., CEG, PFE) is the key risk to monitor.
